# dsm_package (Data Source)

Looks up an installed Synology DSM package by its Package Center identifier.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dsm_package" "container_manager" {
  name = "ContainerManager"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Package Center identifier to look up, for example `ContainerManager` or `FileStation`.

### Read-Only

- `can_uninstall` (Boolean) Whether DSM allows this package to be uninstalled.
- `description` (String) Package description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable package name.
- `id` (String) Package identifier used by DSM Package Center.
- `maintainer` (String) Package maintainer.
- `running` (Boolean) Whether the package is running.
- `status` (String) Raw lifecycle status reported by DSM.
- `version` (String) Installed package version.
